title: 第 3 章 善恶制衡系统正式激活第 4 章 摸清玩法不走原主死路
lines: 漫天黑云压在陆家宅院上空，阴冷阴风绕着院墙来回盘旋，无形的天道威压沉甸甸笼罩整片院落，陆衍站在房门前，抬头望着昏暗的天色，脸色沉了下来。
系统刚刚的预警还在耳边回荡，天道临时升级厄运buff，接下来十二个时辰只要动身前往灵泉山谷，大概率会落入苏辰提前布置的圈套，别说暗中探查阵法，甚至会当场被抓，落一个蓄意行凶、暗算宗门天才的罪名。
一旁的老管家周被突如其来的阴风冻得打了个寒颤，连忙凑到陆衍身边，一脸担忧：“少爷，这天色古怪得很，怕是要下暴雨，要不咱们今晚先歇了，改日再琢磨灵泉的事？”
陆衍轻轻摆手，目光扫过院内各处，受天道厄运影响，陆家不少盆栽莫名连根枯萎，院角拴着的护院猎犬焦躁狂吠，任凭下人怎么安抚都安静不下来，随处都是天道暗中针对的细微征兆。
“暴雨只是表象，是天道在刻意施压，想打乱我所有布局。”陆淡淡开口，他心里清楚，距离系统强制任务只剩最后两天时间，拖得越晚变数越多，苏辰只会不断借助灵泉灵气壮大自身，到时候任务失败，自己丹田破碎当场身死。
想要硬碰硬顶着天道打压外出行不通，陆索性暂时取消深夜探查的计划，转身退回卧房，打算闭门静坐，细细钻研系统规则，从金手指身上寻找破解天道压制的办法。
关好门窗，隔绝外面呼啸阴风，陆盘膝坐在木榻上，再次调出淡蓝色系统面板，逐条重新翻阅善恶制衡的三大核心规则。之前匆忙绑定只看了大致内容，如今身陷天道全方位打压，必须深挖系统隐藏细节，找到克制天道厄运的办法。
【系统规则一：放任苏辰肆意掠夺不义机缘、无限制吸收天道气运，宿主即刻触发抹杀机制，身死道消。】
【系统规则二：精准破坏苏辰不义所得机缘、戳破其伪善布局，属于合规制衡，可领取修为、气运、功法奖励。】
【系统规则三：无故残害无辜、滥杀修士，立刻扣除功德，触发天谴，修为暴跌；坚守良心、救助弱小、不趁私怨施暴，触发良心暴击，获得天道抗性、额外资源。】
陆衍指尖轻点虚拟面板，反复琢磨第三条良心规则，瞬间抓住破局关键。天道靠厄运buff全方位针对自己，可系统的良心功德偏偏是天道规则的天然克星，只要自己多行善事积攒纯正功德，就能一点点冲刷身上的厄运deb，削弱天道施加的负面效果。
原主一辈子走反路，遇事暴怒动手、肆意欺压弱小，一边被天道气运反噬，一边触犯系统惩罚，等于两头挨打，最后落得家破人亡。自己换了思路，不搞暴力抢机缘，只用规则拿回灵泉，再顺带积攒功德，既能完成任务，又能慢慢摆脱天道压制，完美跳出原主的死亡闭环。
“不打打杀杀，只用规则截胡不义机缘，靠善心攒功德反压天道，这路子才算稳妥。”陆衍心中敲定长期生存方案，不再执着连夜潜入灵泉，转而换个思路，先在宗门内部寻找行善攒功德的机会，一点点化解身上的厄运枷锁。
就在陆潜心梳理思路之时，院门外传来急促脚步声，一名陆家打杂小厮慌慌张张跑进来禀报：“少爷，外面外门一处杂役院落出事，苏辰白天收了几名跟班，方才几人借着苏的名头，肆意刁难一名新来的外门弟子，动手打伤对方，那人现在重伤蜷缩在墙角，连疗伤丹药都买不起。”
陆衍眼睛一亮，瞌睡送枕头，现成积攒功德的机会主动送上门。刚想起身出门，天道厄运立马生效，桌上瓷杯无故落地摔碎，脚下地面微微打滑，险些摔倒，显而易见天道不想让自己轻易积攒功德，处处从中作梗。
陆稳住身形，嗤笑一声：“越不想让我行善，我偏偏要去积攒功德，打破你的压制。”
他换上普通灰布衣衫，刻意收敛陆家嫡长子的华贵气质，独自一人低调走出府邸，顺着小厮指引的方位，直奔外门杂役居住的低矮院落。青玄宗外门弟子住所破旧简陋，院墙低矮，角落处，一名衣衫破烂的少年蜷缩在地，左腿淤青肿胀，额头布满磕碰伤痕，身旁散落被撕碎的修行竹简。
三名依附苏辰的外门弟子叉腰站在一旁，满脸嚣张，嘴上还在肆意嘲讽：“就凭你撞见苏师兄私下训斥下人，还敢多嘴，不给你点教训，不知道什么叫做识时务。”
这名少年名叫林小安，几天前无意间在灵泉外围，亲眼看见苏背着众人克扣陆家留守下人月例、动辄放出灵气欺压仆役，随口和好友说了两句闲话，消息辗转传到苏辰跟班耳朵里，几人奉命上门寻衅，借着苏辰的威势随意动手伤人。周围不少外门弟子远远围观，可所有人畏惧苏辰身上的滔天气运，没人敢上前出头，全都冷眼旁观，生怕引火烧身，被天道暗中针对，惹上无妄之灾。
眼看其中一人还要抬脚继续踹伤少年，陆衍快步上前出声喝止：“住手，同门修行，一言不合动手伤人，不合宗门规矩。”
三名跟班转头看见一身普通打扮的陆，一开始没认出身份，只当是不起眼的普通内门弟子，当即面色不善：“哪来的闲人，敢管我们苏师兄定下的事？再多管闲事连你一块收拾。”
其中一人抬手就要朝着陆衍挥拳，可陆早已修炼炼气三层，基本功远超外门混混，抬手轻描淡写挡住来拳，微微一震，对方瞬间痛呼后退，整条手臂发麻无力。
三人这才察觉不对劲，仔细打量陆衍样貌，瞬间脸色发白，认出这就是全宗门人人唾弃的陆家纨绔。他们下意识想起外界传言陆衍蛮横霸道，吓得连连后退，可仗着背后有苏辰撑腰，依旧硬着头皮放狠话：“陆衍，你少仗着陆家势力欺压我们，苏师兄可是天命天骄，惹恼了他，你没好果子吃！”
陆衍懒得和几人废话，没有依仗家世动手报复，既不打骂也不追责，只是淡淡开口：“伤人赔药，拿出三枚低级疗伤丹，赔偿这位弟子损失，此事就此作罢。”
几人不情愿，可刚才一招就被制住，心知打不过，只能不情不愿掏出丹药扔在地上，灰溜溜逃窜离去。
陆弯腰捡起丹药递给林小安，还顺手调动自身微薄灵气，帮对方疏通受损经脉，缓解腿上伤势。林小安愣在原地，满眼难以置信，全宗门人人都说陆衍恶毒跋扈、仗势欺人，眼前之人却出手帮自己解围，还无偿疗伤。
“多谢公子，我无钱报答大恩。”少年连忙躬身行礼，眼眶泛红。
陆摆摆手不留姓名，转身就要离开，不求任何回报。
【叮！宿主出手救助无辜被欺弟子，无索取报酬、不动私刑，达成善心判定，触发初级良心暴击！】【功德+89，微量功德冲刷厄运buff，天道压制削弱5%，体内炼气三层灵气凝滞状态小幅缓解！】【周身萦绕的天道阴晦气运被淡淡金光驱散一小部分。】
系统提示接连在脑海响起，陆能清晰察觉到原本滞涩的丹田灵气顺畅了一丝，头顶宅院上空的厚重黑云，也悄然淡了一小片。实打实的好处落在身上，证明行善攒功德破解天道打压的路子完全可行。
刚处理完这边的事，周伯急匆匆寻来，手里拿着新打探的情报：“少爷，方才收到消息，苏今晚留在灵泉闭关，打算借着夜间浓郁灵气冲刺炼气六层，灵泉阵法因为他粗暴汲取，夜里灵气真空的时间比往日提前半个时辰，是绝佳的动手窗口期，可天道依旧在沿路布置各类意外阻碍。”
陆眼睛一亮，窗口期提前等于多出操作时间，虽说还有天道厄运干扰，但自己已经靠着行善削弱一小部分负面效果。
就在陆暗自敲定深夜动手细节之时，系统新的提示突兀弹出。
【紧急提示：苏辰察觉到灵泉阵法异常，暗中在山谷周边布下简易警戒陷阱，但凡有人夜间潜入灵泉，就会触发警报，苏辰可借着警报当场设伏，反过来栽赃陆衍夜闯盗取机缘！】
content_en:
Dark clouds were hanging over the Lu family's house, and the cold wind was swirling back and forth around the courtyard walls. The invisible pressure of heaven hung heavily over the entire courtyard. Lu Yan stood in front of the door, looking up at the dim sky, his face darkening.
The early warning from the system is still ringing in my ears. Tiandao has temporarily upgraded the bad luck buff. As long as I leave for Lingquan Valley in the next twelve hours, there is a high probability that I will fall into the trap set by Su Chen in advance. Not to mention secretly exploring the formation, I will even be caught on the spot and charged with deliberately committing murder and plotting against the genius of the sect.
The old butler Zhou on the side shivered due to the sudden cold wind. He quickly came to Lu Yan's side with a worried look on his face: "Master, the weather is very weird today. I'm afraid it's going to rain heavily. How about we rest tonight and think about the spiritual spring another day?"
Lu Yan gently waved his hand and glanced around the courtyard. Affected by the bad luck of heaven, many potted plants in the Lu family had inexplicably withered at their roots. The guard dog tied in the corner of the courtyard barked anxiously and could not calm down no matter how much the servants comforted him. There were subtle signs of heaven's secret targeting everywhere.
"The heavy rain is just a symptom. It's God's deliberate pressure to disrupt all my plans." Lu Dandan said. He knew in his heart that there were only two days left before the system's mandatory mission. The later it was delayed, the more variables there would be. Su Chen would only continue to use the spiritual energy of the spiritual spring to strengthen himself. When the mission failed, his Dantian would be shattered and die on the spot.
It was not possible to go out to resist the suppression of Heaven's Law head-on. Lu simply canceled his late-night exploration plan, turned around and retreated to the bedroom, planning to sit quietly behind closed doors, study the system rules in detail, and find a way to break the suppression of Heaven's Law from Gold Finger.
After closing the doors and windows to block out the howling wind outside, Lu sat cross-legged on the wooden couch, once again brought up the light blue system panel, and re-read the three core rules of the balance of good and evil one by one. I only read the general content before hurriedly binding, but now I am under the all-round suppression of Heaven. I must dig deep into the hidden details of the system to find a way to restrain the fate of Heaven.
[System Rule 1: If Su Chen is allowed to plunder unjust opportunities and absorb the fate of heaven without limit, the host will immediately trigger the erasure mechanism and die. 】
[System Rule 2: Precisely destroying Su Chen’s opportunities for unjust gains and exposing his hypocritical layout is a compliance check and balance, and you can receive rewards for cultivation, luck, and skills. 】
[System Rule 3: Kill innocent people for no reason, kill monks indiscriminately, your merits will be deducted immediately, triggering divine punishment, and your cultivation level will plummet; stick to your conscience, help the weak, and do not take advantage of personal grudges to commit violence, trigger a conscience critical strike, and gain heavenly resistance and extra resources. 】
Lu Yan tapped the virtual panel with his fingertips, pondered over the third rule of conscience, and instantly grasped the key to breaking the game. The law of heaven relies on the bad luck buff to target itself in all directions, but the systematic conscience merit is the natural nemesis of the law of heaven. As long as you do more good deeds and accumulate pure merit, you can gradually wash away the bad luck deb on your body and weaken the negative effects exerted by the law of heaven.
The original owner had gone against the grain all his life, getting angry and oppressing the weak and arbitrarily. On the one hand, he was counterattacked by the fate of heaven, and on the other hand, he violated the punishment of the system. This was equivalent to being beaten on both sides, and in the end, his family was broken up and his family was destroyed. I changed my mind and did not use violence to seize the opportunity. I only used the rules to get back the spiritual spring, and then accumulated merits along the way. I could not only complete the task, but also slowly get rid of the suppression of heaven, and perfectly escape the death loop of the original owner.
"Don't fight and kill, only use rules to cut off unjust opportunities, and rely on kindness to accumulate merit to counteract the way of heaven. This is the safest way." Lu Yan finalized a long-term survival plan in his mind, no longer persisted in sneaking into the spiritual spring overnight, and changed his mind. He first looked for opportunities to do good deeds and accumulate merit within the sect, and gradually dissolve the shackles of bad luck on his body.
Just when Lu Qian was sorting out his thoughts, there were hurried footsteps outside the courtyard gate, and a Lu family handyman ran in in a panic and reported: "Master, something happened in the handyman courtyard outside the outer gate. Su Chen took in a few followers during the day. Just now, a few people used Su's name to make things difficult for a new outer disciple and injured him. The man is now seriously injured and huddled in the corner. He can't even afford healing pills."
Lu Yan's eyes lit up, and he gave him a pillow as he felt sleepy. An opportunity to accumulate merit came to his door. Just when I was about to get up and go out, the bad luck of Heaven took effect immediately. The porcelain cup on the table fell to the ground and broke into pieces for no reason. The ground under my feet slipped slightly and I almost fell. It was obvious that Heaven didn't want me to easily accumulate merit and hindered me at every step.
Lu steadied himself and sneered: "The less you want me to do good deeds, the more I want to accumulate merit and break your oppression."
He put on ordinary gray cloth clothes, deliberately restraining the luxurious temperament of the eldest son of the Lu family, walked out of the mansion alone and quietly, followed the direction directed by the servant, and went straight to the low courtyard where the outer gate servants lived. The residence of the outer disciples of the Qingxuan Sect was dilapidated and simple, with low courtyard walls. In the corner, a young man in tattered clothes was curled up on the ground. His left leg was bruised and swollen, and his forehead was covered with bruises. Torn bamboo slips for cultivation were scattered around him.
The three outer disciples who were attached to Su Chen stood aside with their arms akimbo, their faces full of arrogance, and their mouths were still sarcastic: "How dare you talk too much when you catch Senior Brother Su reprimanding his subordinates in private, and don't teach you a lesson? You don't know what it means to know the current affairs."
This young man's name is Lin Xiao'an. He was accidentally outside Lingquan a few days ago and saw with his own eyes that Su was behind everyone's back and deducting the monthly salary of the Lu family's left-behind servants, releasing spiritual energy to bully the servants at every turn. He casually chatted with his friends, and the news spread to the ears of Su Chen's followers. Several people were ordered to come to pick fights, and they used Su Chen's power to hurt people at will. Many outer sect disciples were watching from a distance, but everyone was afraid of Su Chen's monstrous luck. No one dared to step forward. They all watched with cold eyes, fearing that they would get burned, be secretly targeted by heaven, and cause unreasonable disasters.
Seeing that one of them was about to raise his foot and continue to kick the young man, Lu Yan quickly stepped forward and shouted: "Stop, we are practicing in the same sect. It is against the sect's rules to hurt someone if you disagree."
The three followers turned around and saw Lu, who was dressed in ordinary clothes. They did not recognize his identity at first and thought he was an inconspicuous ordinary inner disciple. They immediately looked unkind and said, "Where is this idler who dares to interfere with the affairs decided by our senior brother Su? If you interfere in other matters, you will be punished."
One of them raised his hand and was about to punch Lu Yan, but Lu Yan had already practiced at the third level of qi refining, and his basic skills were far superior to those of outside gangsters. He raised his hand to block the punch lightly, and with a slight shock, the opponent instantly screamed in pain and retreated, his whole arm numb and weak.
Only then did the three of them realize that something was wrong. They carefully looked at Lu Yan's appearance and instantly turned pale, recognizing that this was the playboy of the Lu family who was despised by everyone in the sect. They subconsciously thought of the rumors that Lu Yan was arrogant and domineering, and were so frightened that they backed away. However, with Su Chen's support behind them, they still had the courage to speak harshly: "Lu Yan, don't rely on the power of the Lu family to bully us. Senior Brother Su is a gifted one. If you offend him, you will not suffer the consequences!"
Lu Yan was too lazy to talk nonsense with a few people. He did not rely on his family background to take revenge. He neither beat or scolded nor held accountable. He just said lightly: "Pay for the injury. Take out three low-level healing pills to compensate this disciple for his losses. Let's leave this matter behind."
Several people were reluctant, but they were restrained with just one move. Knowing that they could not beat him, they could only reluctantly take out the elixir and throw it on the ground, and fled in despair.
Lu bent over and picked up the elixir and handed it to Lin Xiaoan. He also mobilized his own meager spiritual energy to help the other party unblock the damaged meridians and relieve the injury on his leg. Lin Xiaoan was stunned on the spot, eyes filled with disbelief. Everyone in the sect said that Lu Yan was vicious, domineering and bullying, but the person in front of him helped him out and treated his injuries for free.
"Thank you so much, sir. I don't have the money to repay your great kindness." The young man quickly bowed and saluted, his eyes red.
Lu waved his hand without leaving his name, turned around and left without asking for anything in return.
【bite! The host rescues the innocent disciple who was bullied, without asking for reward, without lynching, reaching the judgment of benevolence, and triggering a low-level conscience critical strike! 】【Merit +89, a small amount of merit washes away the bad luck buff, the suppression of heaven is weakened by 5%, and the stagnant state of the third layer of spiritual energy in the body is slightly relieved! 】【A small part of the bad luck of heaven lingering around him was dispersed by the faint golden light. 】
System prompts rang in his mind one after another, and Lu Neng could clearly feel that the originally stagnant spiritual energy in his Dantian had become smoother, and the thick black clouds above the house above his head also quietly faded a little. Real benefits accrued to me, proving that it is completely feasible to do good deeds and accumulate merit to overcome the suppression of heaven.
Having just finished dealing with the matter here, Uncle Zhou hurriedly came over, holding the new information in his hand: "Master, I just received the news that Su is staying in Lingquan for retreat tonight, intending to use the rich spiritual energy at night to sprint to the sixth level of Qi refining. Because of his rough absorption of the Lingquan formation, the spiritual energy vacuum at night is half an hour earlier than usual, which is an excellent window period for action, but God is still arranging various unexpected obstacles along the way."
Lu's eyes lit up. The advance of the window period equaled more operating time. Although there was still the interference of bad luck from heaven, he had already weakened a small part of the negative effects by doing good deeds.
Just when Lu An was finalizing the details of the late-night operation, a new prompt from the system suddenly popped up.
[Emergency reminder: Su Chen noticed that the formation of Lingquan was abnormal, and secretly set up simple warning traps around the valley. Whenever someone sneaked into Lingquan at night, the alarm would be triggered. Su Chen could use the alarm to set an ambush on the spot, and in turn frame Lu Yanye for breaking in and stealing the opportunity! 】

title_en: Chapter 3 The system of checks and balances between good and evil is officially activated Chapter 4 Find out how to play the game and avoid the original owner’s death
